technologyMergeTitle: Technology files are merged by exact path
technologyMergeBody: Append overwrites only files with the exact same path. It does not merge technology blocks from a project file into the vanilla source file.
toastWarning: Append done. On conflicts, {conflictCount} base-mod file(s) were overwritten. Want per-file control? Use Differential merge instead.
toastSuccess: Append done. No path conflicts — all your content was added to the base mod as new files.
description: Overlay this project onto an existing mod zip. On a path conflict, your edits win. Best for the "load a mod, edit it here, download a merged zip" flow.
naiveMergeTitle: Overlay merge — your edits win on conflicts
naiveMergeBody: On a path conflict, your edits overwrite the base mod's same-named file. Files unique to the base mod are kept as-is, and files you add are written in your version. Want to review conflicts file by file? Use Differential merge.
folderPickerHint: Open the folder that holds the mod's descriptor.mod, such as a Steam Workshop item under steamapps\workshop\content\394360 or a mod in your mod folder. The program only reads it and never changes it.
folderNotAMod: This folder is not a Hearts of Iron IV mod: it has no descriptor.mod with a mod name. Choose the folder that holds descriptor.mod.
supportNote: Any HOI4 mod zip or mod folder works. The program only reads the base and never changes it; the merged zip is saved to your Downloads folder.
title: Append to existing mod
